comments.author: @worldlifejourneyytb
comments.text: Living in São Tomé & Príncipe looks simple in many ways, but not empty. The tropical forests, fishing villages, Creole culture, and slower pace made me genuinely curious about what life feels like there every day.

replies.author: @BestTravelDocumentary4k
replies.text: That 'leve leve' (easygoing) lifestyle is the true essence of São Tomé & Príncipe! 🏝️ It forces you to slow down and appreciate every moment. Could you see yourself spending a few weeks unplugged in a tranquil fishing village like that?"
